calculation: remaining_episodes * mean observed K16 start-to-commit seconds; forecast anchored to last committed episode, not to record creation time
full_protocol_eta: No reliable completion date; weeks is a rough planning scale only. Audit, paired development comparisons, H1, organization adaptation, clean phi, formal evaluations, 7B and independent training seeds remain.
limitations: Uses existing scheduled snapshot only; no new remote training telemetry was polled.
Constant-throughput extrapolation is descriptive and is not a statistical confidence interval or an end-time guarantee.
Current-run training completion excludes its terminal audit, saved-gradient optimizer replay and scientific review.
No inference of method benefit, convergence or full-protocol completion follows from this estimate.
